我的生活与家庭生活(My Life and family life): 一篇关于家庭生活的A2短文:安娜与格蕾丝的经历和小计划。
Anna bought a dress at the shop yesterday. Both of them like fish and water. Life is full of small surprises. For example, for the sake of your health, sleep earlier.
Grace's birthday is in July. Last Thursday, Anna and Grace went to the family dinner. The family dinner is one of the best places in the city. What's more, the rice is still in the pot.
Anna wrote about the day in the diary. Anna wants to be a nurse in the future. It takes twenty minutes to get to the family dinner by bike. What's more, be careful with that sharp kitchen knife.
Anna and Grace had great fun there. Anna hopes to visit Rome one day. Anna learned a lot about history.
